{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Churn", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of R&D expenses over the past 5 years, scaled by the average total assets over the same period", "rationale": "Firms with volatile R&D expenses may be more likely to experience breakthroughs, but also face higher risks, leading to a premium for their stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Acceleration", "construction": "Compute the difference between the 3-year and 1-year growth rates of total employees, then scale by the 1-year growth rate", "rationale": "Accelerating employee growth may indicate successful expansion and increasing returns to scale, but also potential management challenges", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Variability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of inventory turnover over the past 5 years, then scale by the average inventory turnover over the same period", "rationale": "Firms with highly variable inventory turnover may face operational risks, but also opportunities for improvement, leading to a premium for their stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capex-to-Depreciation Ratio", "construction": "Compute the ratio of capital expenditures to depreciation and amortization expenses over the past year", "rationale": "Firms with high capital expenditures relative to depreciation may be investing in growth opportunities, but also taking on additional risks", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Payable Days Variability", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of days accounts payable over the past 5 years, then scale by the average days accounts payable over the same period", "rationale": "Firms with highly variable accounts payable days may face supply chain risks, but also opportunities for improvement, leading to a premium for their stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Cash Flow Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of operating cash flow over the past 5 years, scaled by the average total assets over the same period", "rationale": "Firms with volatile cash flows may face financial risks, but also opportunities for growth, leading to a premium for their stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director and Officer Ownership Concentration", "construction": "Compute the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of director and officer ownership, based on the number of shares owned by each insider", "rationale": "Firms with concentrated insider ownership may have more aligned incentives, but also potential agency costs", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Segment Growth Diversification", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of segment sales growth rates, based on the sales growth rate of each business segment", "rationale": "Firms with diversified segment growth may face lower risks, but also potential challenges in allocating resources", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Geographic Revenue Diversification", "construction": "Calculate the Herfindahl-Hirschman Index of geographic sales, based on the sales in each region or country", "rationale": "Firms with diversified geographic revenue may face lower risks, but also potential challenges in managing global operations", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Supply Chain Financing Dependence", "construction": "Compute the ratio of accounts payable to cost of goods sold, then scale by the ratio of accounts receivable to sales", "rationale": "Firms with high supply chain financing dependence may face operational risks, but also opportunities for improvement, leading to a premium for their stock returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"}
]}
